run_metashape_pipeline: run the full Metashape photogrammetry pipeline on a dataset directory with all stages including alignment, dense cloud, and model export
run_metashape_part1_only: run only the part1 stages to add photos, calibrate sensors, align cameras, and detect scale bars without building dense models
run_metashape_part2_only: run only the part2 stages to build depth maps, dense cloud, model, texture, and export after part1 is complete
run_metashape_with_rig: run Metashape processing with a specific camera rig like eyeful3.0 or double-fisheye using rig calibration and master camera settings
run_metashape_with_krt: run Metashape processing loading a KRT calibration file to set pre-calibrated intrinsics and extrinsics for each camera sensor
